thanksgiving-side.author: Dana from Tulsa
thanksgiving-side.reason: Stuffing is the whole reason the turkey exists. Crispy edges, soft middle, a little sage. Nothing else on the table comes close.

thanksgiving-side.author: carb_queen_kel
thanksgiving-side.reason: Baked mac with the crunchy top is the first dish to disappear at my family's dinner every single year. That's the real vote.

thanksgiving-side.author: Hollis P.
thanksgiving-side.reason: Mashed potatoes are the foundation. Without them, where does the gravy even go?

nba-player.author: hoopsdad_76
nba-player.reason: Six Finals, six rings, and never even needed a Game 7 to win one. Nobody made losing feel impossible the way he did.

nba-player.author: Keisha in Akron
nba-player.reason: Longevity is greatness too. Two decades at the top and he's the all-time leading scorer. I'm tired of pretending that doesn't count.

nba-player.author: skyhook_sam
nba-player.reason: Six MVPs and a shot nobody could block for twenty years. People skip him because he was quiet about it.

rapper.author: bars_by_bree
rapper.reason: Every album is its own world, and he won a Pulitzer for a rap record. Case closed for me.

rapper.author: Nate from Queens
rapper.reason: Illmatic alone puts him in the conversation. Pure writing, every line means something.

rapper.author: westcoast_lena
rapper.reason: Nobody made you feel more. Angry, tender and funny on the same album, and it still hits today.

movie-villain.author: Priya K.
movie-villain.reason: The breathing, the music, the reveal. He's terrifying for two movies and then breaks your heart in the third.

movie-villain.author: midnight_matinee
movie-villain.reason: Every era gets its own Joker and most of them are great. That's how strong the character is.

movie-villain.author: Gus from Boise
movie-villain.reason: Charming, calm and in a great suit. He's the reason Die Hard works, and no action villain since has topped him.

pizza-topping.author: slice_life_jen
pizza-topping.reason: Those little cups that crisp up and hold the grease are perfect. Pepperoni is undefeated for a reason.

pizza-topping.author: Marco T.
pizza-topping.reason: Mushrooms soak up everything good on the pie. Underrated, and they go with any other topping you throw on.

pizza-topping.author: pineapple_truther
pizza-topping.reason: Sweet with salty works everywhere else in food. I will die on this hill, with ham right next to me.

sitcom.author: Ellie from Scranton
sitcom.reason: I've rewatched it more times than I can count and it still gets me. The cringe, the heart, the slow-burn romance. Perfect.

sitcom.author: yadayada_dev
sitcom.reason: Four dumb little stories that all crash together at the end. The writing is basically clockwork.

sitcom.author: Beth R.
sitcom.reason: Golden Girls holds up better than almost anything from the 80s. Four legends trading one-liners on a couch.

video-game.author: triforce_tom
video-game.reason: It taught every 3D adventure game how to work. Lock-on targeting alone changed everything.

video-game.author: blockparty_ana
video-game.reason: My kids play it, I play it, my dad played it. No game has reached that many people for that long.

video-game.author: retro_rhea
video-game.reason: Simple enough for anyone, deep enough to play forever. Tetris is the purest game ever made.

fast-food-fries.author: frybaby_nina
fast-food-fries.reason: Hot McDonald's fries eaten straight out of the bag on the drive home. Nothing beats it and nothing ever will.

fast-food-fries.author: waffle_fry_wes
fast-food-fries.reason: Waffle fries are built different. More surface, more crunch, and they hold sauce better than any shoestring.

fast-food-fries.author: Rosa from Fresno
fast-food-fries.reason: Curly fries are fun to eat and actually seasoned. Arby's understood the assignment years ago.

breakfast-cereal.author: cereal_after_dark
breakfast-cereal.reason: The milk at the end is the best part of any breakfast. Sweet cinnamon-sugar milk, come on.

breakfast-cereal.author: Jules M.
breakfast-cereal.reason: The one cereal you never get tired of. Good dry, good with milk, good at 2 a.m.

breakfast-cereal.author: Big Lou
breakfast-cereal.reason: The marshmallows make it. Kid me and adult me both agree on this one.

tennis-player.author: baseline_bo
tennis-player.reason: Most Grand Slam titles in men's tennis and a winning record against his two big rivals. The numbers just say it.

tennis-player.author: Marguerite L.
tennis-player.reason: Twenty-three Grand Slam singles titles, and she changed what power tennis looks like for everyone after her.

tennis-player.author: drop_shot_dee
tennis-player.reason: Nobody has ever made it look so easy. Watching him was like watching ballet with a racket.

candy-bar.author: sweettooth_sal
candy-bar.reason: Chocolate and peanut butter is the best combo in candy, and nobody does it better. Easy call.

candy-bar.author: Harper from Omaha
candy-bar.reason: It actually fills you up. Nougat, caramel, peanuts, chocolate. It's basically a meal.

candy-bar.author: Tess the Taster
candy-bar.reason: That snap when you break a piece off is half the fun. Light, crispy, never too sweet.

boxer.author: ringside_renee
boxer.reason: Best in the ring and bigger than the sport outside of it. Nobody else comes close on both counts.

boxer.author: Frankie D.
boxer.reason: Ask the old trainers and they all say Robinson. Pound for pound, the most complete fighter who ever lived.

boxer.author: kayo_kev
boxer.reason: Prime Tyson was the scariest thing in sports. Fights were over before people found their seats.

nfl-quarterback.author: Coach Barb
nfl-quarterback.reason: Four Super Bowls, zero interceptions in any of them, and ice in his veins on the last drive. That's the guy.

nfl-quarterback.author: patsfan_paulie
nfl-quarterback.reason: Seven rings. More than any single franchise has. I don't know what else a quarterback is supposed to do.

nfl-quarterback.author: Darnell from KC
nfl-quarterback.reason: Give him ten more years. He already does things on the field I've never seen anyone even try.

rock-band.author: vinyl_vera
rock-band.reason: They basically invented the modern album in under a decade, and every band since owes them something.

rock-band.author: Gail from Leeds
rock-band.reason: Four people who could each write a hit, plus the best live frontman of all time. Queen for me.

rock-band.author: riff_raff_ryan
rock-band.reason: Heaviest band of their era, and they could still play a folk song that makes you tear up. Range and power.

burger-chain.author: animalstyle_amy
burger-chain.reason: Fresh, cheap and the same every single time. A Double-Double animal style is the best fast food order in the country.

burger-chain.author: Hank B.
burger-chain.reason: Texas will tell you, and Texas is right. Big burgers, spicy ketchup, open all night.

burger-chain.author: Midwest Mel
burger-chain.reason: ButterBurgers and the custard of the day. If you've never been to a Culver's, you're missing out.

superhero.author: gotham_gabe
superhero.reason: No powers, just stubbornness and a lot of planning. He's the best because he's human.

superhero.author: Wen in Queens
superhero.reason: He's a kid worried about rent who still saves the city. Most relatable hero ever made, and the jokes are great.

superhero.author: capeless_cora
superhero.reason: He's the original and the standard every other hero gets measured against. Being good isn't boring.

movie-franchise.author: Lena from Ohio
movie-franchise.reason: I grew up with it and now my kids are growing up with it. No other series has been part of so many lives.

movie-franchise.author: second_breakfast
movie-franchise.reason: Three movies shot back to back that hold up perfectly today. Nobody has pulled off anything like it since.

movie-franchise.author: 007_nights
movie-franchise.reason: Sixty years of the same character and it still works. Every generation gets their own Bond.

ice-cream-flavor.author: scoop_dog_sid
ice-cream-flavor.reason: Best of both worlds, with cookie chunks in every bite. It's what I order when I can't decide.

ice-cream-flavor.author: Nana Bea
ice-cream-flavor.reason: Moose Tracks has fudge swirls and little peanut butter cups in it. Every good thing at once. How is it not on the list?

ice-cream-flavor.author: plain_jane_v
ice-cream-flavor.reason: Vanilla goes with every pie, every cobbler, every cone. It's not boring, it's the foundation.

soccer-player.author: Ines in Lisbon
soccer-player.reason: The hardest-working athlete I've ever seen, and he scored everywhere he played. A total machine.

soccer-player.author: nutmeg_nico
soccer-player.reason: He finally won the World Cup and that ended the debate for me. Nobody has made the ball listen like that.

soccer-player.author: Grandpa Teo
soccer-player.reason: Three World Cups. I watched him as a boy and I've never seen that kind of joy on a field again.

soft-drink.author: fizz_fanatic
soft-drink.reason: It doesn't taste like anything else on the shelf. Dr Pepper is in a class by itself.

soft-drink.author: Carla S.
soft-drink.reason: An ice-cold Coke in a glass bottle. That's it, that's the post.

soft-drink.author: carolina_cass
soft-drink.reason: Cheerwine is a North Carolina treasure. Cherry soda with real bite, and it's amazing with barbecue.

gaming-console.author: ps2_forever
gaming-console.reason: The game library is unreal, and it was also my DVD player for five years. Nothing else came close for me.

gaming-console.author: Marisol R.
gaming-console.reason: The SNES had the best 2D games ever made. Every cartridge on my shelf was a classic.

gaming-console.author: couch_coop_kai
gaming-console.reason: Four controller ports changed my childhood. GoldenEye and Mario Kart with friends on one TV.

comedy-actor.author: Todd in Tucson
comedy-actor.reason: Nobody uses their whole body like him. Ace Ventura made me laugh so hard I cried as a kid.

comedy-actor.author: Ana Lucia
comedy-actor.reason: The funniest man alive in any interview, and he could break your heart in a drama. That range is the GOAT.

comedy-actor.author: sandlerverse
comedy-actor.reason: My friends and I quote his movies every week. Comfort comedy king, no contest.

board-game.author: Meeple Megan
board-game.reason: Trading, luck and strategy all at once, and every game plays differently. It got my whole friend group into board games.

board-game.author: checkmate_chen
board-game.reason: Centuries old and people are still finding new ideas. Nothing else even competes.

board-game.author: Rich from Reno
board-game.reason: It's the one every family owns. Yes, it ruins friendships. That's the point.

disney-animated-movie.author: hakuna_holly
disney-animated-movie.reason: The opening sunrise still gives me chills. Great songs, a great villain, and it makes me cry every time.

disney-animated-movie.author: Dev P.
disney-animated-movie.reason: The Genie carries that movie and it's the funniest Disney ever got. Plus Friend Like Me is a banger.

disney-animated-movie.author: Mei-Lin T.
disney-animated-movie.reason: A hero who saves China her own way, with the best soundtrack of the bunch. That training montage song is unbeatable.

nfl-wide-receiver.author: Niner Nancy
nfl-wide-receiver.reason: He holds basically every receiving record that matters and outworked everyone. It's not close.

nfl-wide-receiver.author: deep_ball_desmond
nfl-wide-receiver.reason: Nobody has ever been more dangerous going deep. You just threw it up and he came down with it.

nfl-wide-receiver.author: Ty from Detroit
nfl-wide-receiver.reason: Megatron was a cheat code. Huge, fast, and he caught anything thrown anywhere near him.

potato-chip.author: crunchtime_cass
potato-chip.reason: Just potato and salt, done perfectly. Every other chip is trying to be this one.

potato-chip.author: Wade H.
potato-chip.reason: The ridges hold all that cheddar powder. Best chip for movie night, every time.

potato-chip.author: dill_with_it
potato-chip.reason: Dill pickle is the most underrated flavor in the chip aisle. Tangy, salty, and the bag is gone in one sitting.

guitarist.author: fuzz_pedal_phil
guitarist.reason: He played the guitar like it was a whole new instrument. More than fifty years later, people are still catching up.

guitarist.author: Lucia from Austin
guitarist.reason: Nobody played the blues with more fire. Texas Flood still sounds like it's about to burn the speakers.

guitarist.author: two_hand_tap_tim
guitarist.reason: Eruption changed the life of every teenager who heard it. He reinvented how people play.

car-brand.author: Gearhead Greta
car-brand.reason: The 911 has been around for decades and it's still the benchmark. Every drive feels like an event.

car-brand.author: Sam from Dayton
car-brand.reason: Mine has 280,000 miles on it and still starts every morning. Reliability is the whole game.

car-brand.author: trail_rated_tia
car-brand.reason: Nothing else lets you take the doors off and go anywhere. Jeep people wave at each other for a reason.

steak-cut.author: grillmaster_gwen
steak-cut.reason: All that marbling means flavor in every bite. Ribeye wins and it isn't even close.

steak-cut.author: Mr. Okafor
steak-cut.reason: Tender enough to cut with a fork. My special-occasion steak forever.

steak-cut.author: fogo_fan_fran
steak-cut.reason: Once you've had picanha with the fat cap crisped up on a skewer, you get it. Brazil figured this out.

tv-drama.author: blue_sky_billy
tv-drama.reason: Every season is better than the one before, and the ending actually sticks the landing. Almost no show does that.

tv-drama.author: Joanne from Jersey
tv-drama.reason: Everything good on TV after it owes something to this show. It's the blueprint.

tv-drama.author: clear_eyes_cody
tv-drama.reason: The most honest show about family and small towns ever made. Coach and Mrs. Taylor are the best TV marriage, period.

olympic-athlete.author: lane_four_lou
olympic-athlete.reason: Twenty-three gold medals. That number is so big it doesn't even look real.

olympic-athlete.author: Kiara from Kingston
olympic-athlete.reason: He made the 100 meters look like a jog and smiled the whole way. And he still holds the world records.

olympic-athlete.author: flip_it_frankie
olympic-athlete.reason: She has skills named after her that almost nobody else will even attempt. That's GOAT stuff.

breakfast-food.author: sizzle_suzie
breakfast-food.reason: Bacon makes every other breakfast item better. That's the definition of the GOAT.

breakfast-food.author: Ramon G.
breakfast-food.reason: Eggs, potatoes, cheese and salsa, all wrapped up so you can eat it in the car. Peak breakfast engineering.

breakfast-food.author: shortstack_sue
breakfast-food.reason: Chilaquiles should be on this list. Crispy tortillas, salsa, a fried egg on top. Nothing better on a Sunday.

action-movie-star.author: terminator_tina
action-movie-star.reason: Terminator 2, Predator, Commando. He defined the action hero for a whole generation.

action-movie-star.author: stunt_reel_raj
action-movie-star.reason: He does his own stunts and makes them funny. Watch the outtakes over the credits and tell me anyone else is close.

action-movie-star.author: Brenda K.
action-movie-star.reason: He's in his sixties and still hanging off real airplanes. Nobody has ever been this committed.

golfer.author: fore_fiona
golfer.reason: He changed who watches golf. The 2019 Masters had me crying in my living room.

golfer.author: Walt from Columbus
golfer.reason: Eighteen majors. Until somebody beats that, the Golden Bear is the answer.

golfer.author: nineteenth_hole_ned
golfer.reason: He made golf cool for regular people. Arnie's Army was real, and he earned every one of those fans.

cookie.author: Maddie Bakes
cookie.reason: Warm, gooey, just out of the oven. Chocolate chip is the cookie every other cookie wants to be.

cookie.author: dunk_squad_dan
cookie.reason: Twist, lick, dunk. It's a whole ritual, and no other cookie has one.

cookie.author: Auntie Joy
cookie.reason: Thin Mints straight from the freezer. Girl Scout cookie season is the best few weeks of the year.

cartoon-series.author: springfield_stan
cartoon-series.reason: The golden-era seasons are still the funniest TV ever made. It's been on so long it predicted half of real life.

cartoon-series.author: bikinibottom_bri
cartoon-series.reason: Every meme I send is SpongeBob. Funny for kids, even funnier for adults.

cartoon-series.author: Theo from Portland
cartoon-series.reason: The best story ever told in a cartoon, with real character growth. Zuko's arc alone wins it.

sneaker-brand.author: sole_collector_cj
sneaker-brand.reason: The 1s and the 11s are art. Nothing else has that history or that hype.

sneaker-brand.author: Pam the Runner
sneaker-brand.reason: Comfortable, good-looking, and they last forever. The dads were right all along.

sneaker-brand.author: Swoosh Steph
sneaker-brand.reason: Running, basketball, soccer, everyday. Nike makes a top shoe in every single category.

nfl-running-back.author: lions_lifer_lyle
nfl-running-back.reason: Every carry was a highlight. He'd go backwards twenty yards to gain five and you couldn't look away.

nfl-running-back.author: Sheila from Chicago
nfl-running-back.reason: He never ran out of bounds if he could hit somebody instead. Toughest player I ever watched.

nfl-running-back.author: brownsbacker_bert
nfl-running-back.reason: Led the league almost every year and walked away at the top. Most dominant player the sport has ever seen.

pasta-dish.author: Nonna Carmela
pasta-dish.reason: Layers of sauce, cheese and pasta, baked low and slow. Sunday lasagna is my love language.

pasta-dish.author: al_dente_dave
pasta-dish.reason: Eggs, cheese, guanciale and black pepper. A handful of ingredients and it's perfect. No cream, please.

pasta-dish.author: Kristy W.
pasta-dish.reason: Creamy, cheesy, comforting. I'm not ashamed. It's what I order at every Italian place.

plot-twist-movie.author: spoiler_alert_ali
plot-twist-movie.reason: I saw it in theaters with zero spoilers and my jaw hit the floor. Then you rewatch and the clues were all right there.

plot-twist-movie.author: Owen in Denver
plot-twist-movie.reason: Those last five minutes. Best ending in movie history, and I still think about that coffee mug.

plot-twist-movie.author: rule_one_rita
plot-twist-movie.reason: The twist works on the first watch and changes everything on the second. The rewatch value is insane.

superpower.author: Zoe from Phoenix
superpower.reason: No traffic, no flights. Breakfast in Paris and lunch in Tokyo. Teleportation is the most useful power by far.

superpower.author: up_up_ursula
superpower.reason: Flying is the dream everyone has as a kid. Pure freedom is the best superpower there is.

superpower.author: chrono_cal
superpower.reason: Fix your mistakes, see history, peek at the future. Time travel beats everything else on this list.

fictional-character.author: Bookworm Bettina
fictional-character.reason: Over a century old and still the template for every detective on TV. That's staying power.

fictional-character.author: donut_derek
fictional-character.reason: The funniest character ever written. I quote him more than any real person I know.

fictional-character.author: Gina from Mesa
fictional-character.reason: Atticus Finch belongs on here. Quiet courage, doing the right thing when the whole town is against you.

best-picture-winner.author: film_buff_fernando
best-picture-winner.reason: Every scene is perfect. Fifty years later it's still the movie other directors study.

best-picture-winner.author: Paula from Erie
best-picture-winner.reason: It makes me laugh and cry in the same scene. My comfort movie, and it took home Best Picture.

best-picture-winner.author: subtitle_sun
best-picture-winner.reason: The first non-English-language film to win Best Picture, and it earned it. Tense, funny and shocking.

bbq-food.author: pitmaster_paco
bbq-food.reason: Twelve hours on the smoker, that bark, the jiggle when you slice it. Brisket is the king of barbecue.

bbq-food.author: Dottie from Memphis
bbq-food.reason: Dry-rub ribs and a cold drink on a hot day. That's barbecue to me.

bbq-food.author: kc_bbq_kenny
bbq-food.reason: Kansas City took the best bite of the brisket and made a whole dish out of it. Meat candy.

romantic-movie.author: Rachel M.
romantic-movie.reason: The rain scene! I've seen it twenty times and I still cry at the end every time.

romantic-movie.author: cinema_sofia
romantic-movie.reason: Funny, smart, and the most believable romance on film. The New Year's Eve speech is perfect.

romantic-movie.author: Grace from Bath
romantic-movie.reason: The hand flex scene alone wins it. Every frame is gorgeous and the slow burn is perfect.

super-bowl-snack.author: wing_king_wally
super-bowl-snack.reason: Super Bowl Sunday is wing day. Blue cheese, celery, extra napkins. Done.

super-bowl-snack.author: Tasha from Tampa
super-bowl-snack.reason: One giant tray of nachos in the middle of the room feeds everybody. Best party food ever.

super-bowl-snack.author: dip_diva_deb
super-bowl-snack.reason: At every party I go to, the dip is gone by halftime. That tells you everything.

horror-movie.author: Victor N.
horror-movie.reason: Decades later it's still the one people are scared to watch alone. Pure dread from start to finish.

horror-movie.author: haddonfield_hugo
horror-movie.reason: That theme music alone is terrifying. It made the slasher movie what it is.

horror-movie.author: Ivy from Salem
horror-movie.reason: Jaws is a horror movie and the best one ever made. It kept people out of the ocean for a whole summer.

christmas-movie.author: Merry Maria
christmas-movie.reason: My family watches it every year and we still laugh at the paint cans. The perfect Christmas movie.

christmas-movie.author: nakatomi_nate
christmas-movie.reason: Yes, it's a Christmas movie. It takes place on Christmas Eve at an office party. Best one ever.

christmas-movie.author: griswold_gary
christmas-movie.reason: Cousin Eddie, the lights, the squirrel. Every December I quote this movie nonstop.

nfl-tight-end.author: gridiron_greg
nfl-tight-end.reason: Best blocker and best receiver at the same time. In his prime you couldn't cover him with one guy.

nfl-tight-end.author: Chiefs Kingdom Kat
nfl-tight-end.reason: Watch the playoffs. He's always open when it matters most, and he's been doing it for a decade.

nfl-tight-end.author: Pete from Pasadena
nfl-tight-end.reason: Seventeen seasons and he caught everything. The model for every pass-catching tight end since.

nfl-offensive-lineman.author: trench_warfare_tj
nfl-offensive-lineman.reason: Ask anyone who watched those 80s Bengals. Big, quick feet, and nobody ever seemed to beat him.

nfl-offensive-lineman.author: Bev from Garland
nfl-offensive-lineman.reason: The strongest man I ever saw on a football field. Defensive linemen did not want to line up across from him.

nfl-offensive-lineman.author: o_line_ollie
nfl-offensive-lineman.reason: Didn't miss a snap for over ten years, on some rough Browns teams. Pure consistency deserves the crown.

nfl-defensive-lineman.author: sackmaster_sonya
nfl-defensive-lineman.reason: The Minister of Defense could throw anybody aside with that hump move. Strong as an ox and relentless.

nfl-defensive-lineman.author: Rams House Ricky
nfl-defensive-lineman.reason: Double-teamed every play and still wrecked games. Never seen an interior lineman like him.

nfl-defensive-lineman.author: Gerald in Gary
nfl-defensive-lineman.reason: He gave us the word sack, and his head slap was so good they banned it. The original.

nfl-linebacker.author: blitz_betty
nfl-linebacker.reason: He changed how offenses blocked. Teams built whole game plans around stopping one guy.

nfl-linebacker.author: Kendra from Towson
nfl-linebacker.reason: The heart of one of the best defenses ever, and he did it for seventeen years. Total intensity.

nfl-linebacker.author: monsters_midway_mo
nfl-linebacker.reason: The most ferocious tackler who ever played. Running backs felt him for a week after.

nfl-defensive-back.author: pick_six_pat
nfl-defensive-back.reason: Quarterbacks just stopped throwing his way. Half the field was closed the second he lined up.

nfl-defensive-back.author: Lorraine B.
nfl-defensive-back.reason: He read quarterbacks better than they read him. Every pick felt like he knew the play first.

nfl-defensive-back.author: safety_first_sean
nfl-defensive-back.reason: Had a fingertip cut off so he wouldn't miss time, hit like a truck, and won four rings. Toughest DB ever.

pop-singer.author: moonwalk_maria
pop-singer.reason: Thriller is still the best-selling album ever. Nobody else had the voice, the dancing and the videos all at once.

pop-singer.author: Danny in Detroit
pop-singer.reason: She reinvented herself every few years for four decades and kept filling arenas the whole time. That's the Queen of Pop for me.

pop-singer.author: highnote_hannah
pop-singer.reason: That a cappella opening of I Will Always Love You settles it. Pure voice, no tricks, best singer of my lifetime.

grunge-band.author: flannel_frank
grunge-band.reason: Nevermind knocked Michael Jackson off the top of the Billboard chart. One album changed what all of radio sounded like.

grunge-band.author: Seattle Steph
grunge-band.reason: Ten is a perfect record and they're still out there touring decades later. Eddie Vedder's voice hasn't lost a thing.

grunge-band.author: badmotorfinger88
grunge-band.reason: Chris Cornell had that four-octave range and Kim Thayil's riffs were heavier than anybody's. Superunknown still hits hard.

drummer.author: bonzo_beats
drummer.reason: Listen to the intro of When the Levee Breaks. That beat has been sampled for decades. Bonzo had the heaviest feel ever.

drummer.author: Rush fan Raj
drummer.reason: He wrote Rush's lyrics and played like a whole orchestra behind that giant kit. Tom Sawyer is a clinic every single time.

drummer.author: Mod Squad Mel
drummer.reason: Total chaos that somehow held The Who together. Nobody played the drums like a lead instrument the way Moon did.

nfl-team.author: Terrible Towel Tina
nfl-team.reason: Six Super Bowl rings, tied for the most ever. The Steel Curtain defense of the 70s is still the standard for me.

nfl-team.author: Niner Nate
nfl-team.reason: Five rings in fourteen seasons, and that West Coast offense changed how football is played forever.

nfl-team.author: Foxboro Phil
nfl-team.reason: Six Super Bowl wins and nine trips in under twenty years. That Brady and Belichick run will never happen again.

nfl-player.author: slant_route_sal
nfl-player.reason: He holds pretty much every receiving record and most aren't even close. Outworked everyone for 20 seasons.

nfl-player.author: Tammy from Tampa
nfl-player.reason: Seven Super Bowl rings, more than any single franchise has. Hard to argue with winning like that.

nfl-player.author: blitz_brandon
nfl-player.reason: Teams had to change how they blocked just to deal with him. He won MVP as a defensive player, which almost never happens.

nba-point-guard.author: Showtime Shirley
nba-point-guard.reason: Five titles, and he played center as a rookie in the Finals. A 6'9 point guard who made everyone around him better.

nba-point-guard.author: splash_zone_zach
nba-point-guard.reason: He changed how the entire league plays. Every kid launching from deep right now is copying Steph.

nba-point-guard.author: Cincy Carl
nba-point-guard.reason: Averaged a triple double for a whole season back in the 60s. It took over fifty years for anyone to do it again.

nba-shooting-guard.author: Bulls fan Bev
nba-shooting-guard.reason: Six Finals, six titles, six Finals MVPs, and never once needed a Game 7. That's the GOAT for me, end of discussion.

nba-shooting-guard.author: mamba_marco
nba-shooting-guard.reason: Five rings, 81 points in one game, and that work ethic. Mamba mentality is why I still get up early to shoot.

nba-shooting-guard.author: Heat Check Hector
nba-shooting-guard.reason: That 2006 Finals run was one of the best ever. Plus he blocked more shots than any guard his size in league history.

nba-center.author: Lakers Lou
nba-center.reason: Six MVPs, six rings, and a skyhook nobody could stop. He held the career scoring record for almost 40 years.

nba-center.author: diesel_dana
nba-center.reason: Three straight Finals MVPs and teams had to invent hack-a-Shaq. Most dominant big man I ever watched.

nba-center.author: Philly Phyllis
nba-center.reason: 100 points in one game and 50 a night for a full season. Some of his records will never be touched.

nba-small-forward.author: the_chosen_wun
nba-small-forward.reason: All-time leading scorer, four rings with three teams, and still great after 20 years. Nobody's done it this long.

nba-small-forward.author: Celtic Colleen
nba-small-forward.reason: Three straight MVPs and the best trash talker ever. Larry Legend backed up every word he said.

nba-small-forward.author: OKC Olivia
nba-small-forward.reason: Nearly seven feet tall and shoots like a guard. Two Finals MVPs, and he can get a bucket against anyone.

nba-power-forward.author: Spurs Sue
nba-power-forward.reason: Five rings across three different decades and never any drama. The Big Fundamental just won, year after year.

nba-power-forward.author: Mailman Mike
nba-power-forward.reason: Second in career points when he retired and he almost never missed a game. The Mailman always delivered.

nba-power-forward.author: KG_fan_Kendra
nba-power-forward.reason: Nobody played with more fire. MVP, Defensive Player of the Year, and he turned the Celtics into champs in one season.

mlb-player.author: twoway_tomoko
mlb-player.reason: An ace pitcher and an MVP hitter at the same time, plus the first 50 homer, 50 steal season ever. Never seen anything like it.

mlb-player.author: Bambino Bob
mlb-player.reason: Babe was an ace pitcher in Boston, then became the greatest home run hitter alive. He basically invented the modern game.

mlb-player.author: Giants Gina
mlb-player.reason: 660 homers, 12 Gold Gloves and that catch in the 54 World Series. Willie did everything on a ball field.

mlb-outfielder.author: centerfield_cal
mlb-outfielder.reason: Best center fielder ever and it's not close. He could hit, run, throw and catch better than anyone in his time.

mlb-outfielder.author: Yankee Yolanda
mlb-outfielder.reason: Babe hit 60 homers in 1927 and held the career home run record until 1974. Nobody was further ahead of his era.

mlb-outfielder.author: Braves Bernadette
mlb-outfielder.reason: 755 homers with total class through everything he faced chasing Ruth. Still the all-time RBI leader, too.

mlb-infielder.author: iron_horse_irene
mlb-infielder.reason: 2,130 straight games and a .340 hitter for his career. The Iron Horse was the toughest player who ever lived.

mlb-infielder.author: stat_head_stu
mlb-infielder.reason: 696 homers, three MVPs, and Gold Glove defense at shortstop. The raw talent was off the charts.

mlb-infielder.author: Bleacher Bo
mlb-infielder.reason: Five rings, 3,465 hits and always clutch in October. The Flip Play alone gets my vote.

mlb-catcher.author: Reds Rhonda
mlb-catcher.reason: Ten straight Gold Gloves and two MVPs for the Big Red Machine. The total package behind the plate.

mlb-catcher.author: Queens Quentin
mlb-catcher.reason: Ten World Series rings as a player, more than anyone in baseball, and Yogi was a three-time MVP too.

mlb-catcher.author: Mets Maddie
mlb-catcher.reason: Most home runs ever by a catcher. That homer at Shea after 9/11 still gives me chills.

mlb-pitcher.author: radar_gun_rosie
mlb-pitcher.reason: Seven no-hitters and 5,714 strikeouts. Those are two records nobody is ever going to break.

mlb-pitcher.author: Desert Dave
mlb-pitcher.reason: Five Cy Youngs, four of them in a row, and a perfect game at 40. The Big Unit was terrifying to face.

mlb-pitcher.author: Peachtree Paula
mlb-pitcher.reason: Four straight Cy Youngs with a fastball that barely touched 90. Pure control and brains, a true artist.
